profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta
profile.summary: I have been a programmer since 2003 and have loved every minute of it as a i believe it is one of my true passions in life.  I have worked on several high profile clients as well as created my own software to better my daily tasks.  I have dealt with so many different languages, picking up new ones are like second nature to me.  I have been able to adapt to any project, style of coding, or architecture that i've been put up to.  Not only do I enjoy coding as a job, I also enjoy doing it on my own personal time.

positions.title: Lead Technical Consultant
positions.description:
Worked on a vast range of clients doing React.js, Vue.js, Angular.js Javascript, Typescript, HTML5, CSS, SASS, ASP.NET, node.js, C#, Sitecore, Sharepoint and more.  Worked on projects for the following clients:

-Meta

-Toyota
-Honda
-Mastercard
-Humana
-Pathway Capital
and more
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · TypeScript · React.js · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · ASP.NET MVC · jQuery · Bootstrap (Framework) · ASP.NET Web API · Vue.js · Next.js · AngularJS

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Developed and architected a decision making app that let users create decisions and invite their friends to vote in real-time on a final decision.  Built full API for mobile and web, using ASP.NET C# WebAPI and MongoDB.  The API sent push notifications to mobile devices using parse.  Also managed two interns developing in Android and iOS to create the mobile APP.  Created the entire web interface in HTML, CSS, jQuery and Javascript.

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description: Fully architected and developed a chat roulette style website that was made specifically for UC students using a html5 webcam API.  Built the entire application using C#, ASP.NET MVC, Javascript, Jquery, HTML5 and CSS.  Faced challenges of creating a real-time chat and real-time pairing using SignalR, long-polling and Redis.  Took the project from development mode to production.

positions.title: Associate Developer
positions.description: Worked on high profile clients such as Disney, LSI and more doing Sharepoint development that included C#, ASP.NET, Javascript, HTML, and CSS.
